body:
Check the ACTUS UMP01 initial-exchange specimen through the actual public Core parse, validate and simulate functions. A typed adapter reads the actual cashflow, emitted event, state and persistent principal duty; the regression compares full pre/post state, all 12 prefixes, seven ordered effects and seven finite financial quantities against a separately frozen oracle.

Validation on `97c9b1565d71404413aa35e9f95fe7661b8a09b1`: one selected regression passed (25.857s including cold build), three existing tests filtered. Lender and borrower each finish with 1000; borrower principal duty 1000 remains outstanding. Independent oracle custody: 39 members, freeze `ebf385af5db731fdcc037f43ce685b6cdb7c3006a1b6900f3cf90ad99451a7d4`, verified before execution. Source pins stayed unchanged; temporary output was removed.

Scope: the integral, absent-rate initial-exchange branch and explicit fixture-only subject mapping. This does not assert original upstream scalar-wire encoding, complete ACTUS state schema, all events or family conformance. The independently counted 32 logical units are specified, not observed through a metered call. No compiler/native/proof/ledger qualification. Upstream license/fixture whitespace is preserved with exact custody records. This draft awaits fresh independent source/result review.

title: Validate ACTUS UMP initial exchange with an independent Core oracle
